title: A Detailed Factor Analysis for the Political Compass Test: Navigating Ideologies of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Political Compass Test (PCT) and the 8 Values Test to Large Language Models (LLMs) to calculate ideological coordinates (such as social and economic scores), and analyzing how these scores are impacted by different text generation prompts, decoding parameters (temperature, top_k, num_beams), and fine-tuning on politically rich versus neutral datasets.
